## Summary

Describe the behavior and why it belongs in Agent Hub Demo.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run runtime100`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Commits are signed off (DCO)

## Contract and provider governance

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, secrets, private logs, or production data
- [ ] Provider APIs, CLIs, telemetry, billing, quota, or usage attribution are unchanged or explained
- [ ] Official hosted or managed services are unchanged or explained
- [ ] Official branding, package names, release identity, or domains are unchanged or explained
- [ ] Release evidence, provenance, package publishing, or deployment surfaces are unchanged or explained
- [ ] Generic KFD or Buildchain friction is linked to an upstream issue rather than copied locally
- [ ] The public claim boundary remains accurate
